messages:
maya: Heads up — nightly evals flagged a regression on the SessionWindow prompt set for 16k runs. EMR down ~3.8% vs yesterday. Anyone seen related failures for long examples?

nightly-evals-bot: [artifact] nightly/evals/sessionwindow/1738456789 -> failure rate 3.8% (16k context). Diff: repeated truncation mid-answer on ~120 tests. Artifact: https://internal.artifacts/redwood/nightly/sessionwindow/1738456789

sam: looked at a couple repros on the q4_8 build — I see output cut off around token ~8234. Logs show repeated `kv_fetch_miss` followed by `seq_offset negative` for the same session id.

alex: hmm that sounds like the session window index wrapped or we lost mapping for the session id. Did the job hit any autoscale / restart?

maya: no restarts in the hosted job. repro command I used: `curl -s -X POST https://internal-eval/redwood/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer $EVAL_KEY' -d '{"model":"rwd-bert-long-16k","context":"<long prompt file>","stream":false}'` — same truncation.

carlos: saw a similar pattern on Dedicated after a deploy yesterday. In my case the worker process reset but the redis slot metadata didn't persist, so KV lookups returned empty and we fell back to recompute, but the code path then increments the seq counter and later treats it as negative when compared to persisted anchors.

jen: I ran a debug build with KV logging enabled against a failing prompt. snippet of the log:

```
[2025-11-02T03:12:45Z] session=sn_7a4f kv_slot=1048574 token_index=8229 kv_fetch_miss
[2025-11-02T03:12:45Z] session=sn_7a4f kv_slot=-2 seq_offset=-4294967294 anchor=1048576
[2025-11-02T03:12:45Z] WARNING: prefix_eviction_calc overflow: tokens_seen=66321 window_cap=65536
```

jen: looks like a signed/unsigned wrap in the prefix eviction math when tokens_seen > window cap.

sam: that matches my repro. Could be a 32-bit int overflow when computing KV offsets for very long contexts. We started hitting >64k tokens in a few synthetic tests.

alex: I'll spin up a debug eval with int64 math and no eviction to confirm. If it disappears, then the unsigned wrap is the culprit.

maya: temporary mitigation — set `prefix_eviction_max=32768` on the eval runner and re-run nightly to reduce immediate failures. I can push that for tonight if you all agree.

carlos: +1 for mitigation, but we should trace persistence logic too. If worker restarts lose slot map, we get duplicates that push slot counters high.

jen: action items: alex to run int64 debug compare (ETA 2h), sam to bisect between float16 vs q4_8 builds (ETA EOD), maya to flip prefix_eviction_max for tonight and post results. I'll open a bug with logs and link the artifact.

alex: running now — will post logs.

sam: if we confirm overflow, we should also add a unit test with extremely long synthetic token streams to catch future regressions.

maya: thanks — will follow up in the morning with nightly results. :thumbsup:

nightly-evals-bot: update scheduled: nightly/evals/sessionwindow/1738456789-rerun queued by maya (prefix_eviction_max=32768).
